author: reek
body: Stage 5: structural induction with a BINARY constructor. `append xs Nil === xs` over a user-defined list. The MyCons case reduces to `MyCons h (append t MyNil) === MyCons h t`, discharged by `cong ih` where ih is `append t MyNil === t`. Here `cong` must solve its function variable to `MyCons h` -- a PARTIAL application of a 2-argument constructor -- which the unifier handles by peeling the saturated constructor `MyCons h X` as a curried type application `(MyCons h) X`. add-zero only needed unary `Succ`; this needs the N-ary peel.
